brief_summary: This is a multicenter, randomized, open, positive parallel controlled phase III clinical trial to compare the efficacy and safety of once-weekly HD1916 and semaglutide injection and to evaluate immunogenicity in obese non-diabetic adults.
official_title: To Evaluate a Multicenter, Randomized, Open, Positive Parallel Controlled Phase III Clinical Trial of Semaglutide Injection (HD1916) in the Treatment of Obesity

primary_outcomes.measure: Relative percentage change in body weight from baseline at 44 weeks of treatment
